producer_report.summary: I registered the study capability in the CLI. `capabilities()` in wiring.rs now returns both `Change` and `Study`, and athena-cli depends on `athena-cap-study`. architecture.md lists the new cli → cap-study edge and now says the crate is "Registered in the CLI". The crate doc comment, the design doc's Partly built note and CHANGELOG say the same. A new unit test in wiring.rs asserts the registered ids include `change` and `study` with no duplicates. Registration made two token-budget tests fail: the reader catalog and the study producer prompt were over budget. I shortened the study capability card text and `prompts/producer.md` to fit. The prompt keeps its rules but is reworded more tightly. fmt, clippy with warnings denied and the full test suite all pass. The firstmate M1 study is not started and nothing about firstmate is claimed.

checks_run.note: includes xtask policy tests and the budgets test

open_issues: The fixed 'Cargo.lock' edge is generated: I did not open it, but the --locked checks pass, so it already reflects the edge.
docs/decisions.md and athena.toml are unchanged on purpose: the call does not differ from D64/D65, and no [capabilities.study] section was added.
xtask/tests/policy.rs and crates/athena-cli/tests/binary.rs are unchanged. The registration test is a unit test in wiring.rs.
Starting the firstmate M1 study is not done, as agreed. It needs a pin, containment, the run step and the Pages design.
The study card text and producer prompt were shortened to fit the token budgets. Please review the wording, since a prompt change is a behavior change.
mistakes: I first ran cargo test with a pipe to grep, which the hook denied. I re-ran without it.
I only found the budget overruns after registering the capability. The study card and producer prompt had never been counted against them.
learnings: Registering a capability adds its card to the reader catalog and its producer section to the per-capability producer set. Both are checked against fixed token budgets in crates/athena-cli/tests/budgets.rs (reader 1800, producer 1100).
xtask/tests/policy.rs reads the edges from docs/architecture.md and Cargo manifests, so it needed no edit.
Bash in this environment allows no grep or pipes.
